exercises.title: RTM procedure 1 — the nine-step tracing procedure
exercises.problemHtml:
Wiegers’ procedure for tracing requirements. Put the steps in order.

Drag the items into the right order; the explanation appears after you submit.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.

exercises.title: RTM procedure 2 — link cardinality
exercises.problemHtml:
Trace links can be one-to-one (one design element → one code module), one-to-many (one requirement verified by several tests) or many-to-many (use cases ↔ functional requirements, some requirements shared by several use cases).

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.

exercises.title: RTM procedure 3 — a pairwise matrix
exercises.problemHtml:
Table 29-2 is a two-way matrix of use cases ↔ functional requirements. Write function matrix(ucs, frs, links) returning a 2-D array: one row per use case (in the order of ucs), one column per FR (order of frs), each cell true if the link exists. Then write function shared(links) returning the sorted FRs used by more than one use case, and function emptyRows(ucs, links) returning the use cases with no FR (in the order of ucs).

Requirements

  • Links are [uc, fr] pairs; ignore duplicates.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Viết matrix (ma trận UC × FR), shared (FR dùng bởi hơn một UC, sắp xếp) và emptyRows (UC không có FR).

Yêu cầu

  • Liên kết là cặp [uc, fr]; bỏ trùng.

exercises.title: RTM procedure 4 — storage and auditing
exercises.problemHtml:
Store trace data in a text table, a spreadsheet or — much better — a requirements management tool. Start tracing with critical core functions, high-risk portions or high-maintenance areas. Audit periodically: if a requirement is "implemented and verified" yet its trace data is incomplete, the process is not working.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Lưu dữ liệu truy vết; bắt đầu từ phần quan trọng; kiểm định kỳ.

Yêu cầu

  • Trả lời mọi câu trong khung trả lời rồi bấm Nộp.
  • Đúng hết mới được Accepted; giải thích từng câu hiện sau khi nộp.
